speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are a pregnant patient presenting with vaginal bleeding and abdominal pain. To ensure the safety of you and your baby, I need to know how many weeks pregnant you are and exactly when these symptoms began. Can you also tell me the color and amount of the bleeding?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old woman, gravida 2, para 1, at 38 weeks' gestation. The patient reports experiencing vaginal bleeding for the past hour accompanied by severe abdominal pain. She mentions that she felt contractions before the onset of the bleeding, but the contractions ceased once the bleeding began. Her first childbirth was a cesarean section due to nonreassuring fetal heart rate.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Placenta Accreta Spectrum (suspected). Given your history of a prior cesarean section and the presentation of vaginal bleeding with abdominal pain at 38 weeks, this is a medical emergency requiring immediate stabilization and consultation with interventional radiology and urology. Please proceed to the delivery room immediately for preparation of a multidisciplinary surgical team.
